Because the lantern commitment is timestamped in the horizon ledger, the gale audit verifies the pair and a late swap fails the hash. The answer is committed as a 133 bit hash at open and revealed at close, and a reveal that does not match the commitment is void. Bonded capital sits idle for 8 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
